Turn 45: 49/50 solves used. Best valid = 0 (empty plant). Current 90-stage R=4 feed column with liquid side draw stage 55 FAILED to converge -> invalid.

Lessons this run: (1) tall high-reflux columns (200 st, R=12) fail to converge; keep to moderate 60-90 st, R<=4-6. (2) side_draw stage must not equal the feed stage; feed is the middle stage (n/2). (3) Every single-column and cascade attempt lost money: no stream reached 95% purity, and a minimal column costs ~$120-150M/yr while the empty plant is 0. (4) Single cuts can't isolate 95% products here because each cut fraction is contaminated by lighter components (e.g. C4-and-lighter tops is ~13% C3-). (5) Mid-weight blend cuts (C4/C5/C6 mixes) would need side draws or cascades whose energy/capital cost exceeds the blend value at this cost level.

Plan: revert to empty valid design to lock in 0, then finish. The empty design guarantees validity and is my best attainable score.
